title: Carriage Desk Note: the Route Back and the Window It Fixes on a Northbeam Returns and Restocking Collection
content:
The route the item must travel back on fixes the window as follows. Where the service the item was delivered on offers no slot inside the crew lead threshold days and the schedule charges a freight collection fee, the window is the schedule's label validity days plus the freight slot days. Where that service offers no slot inside the crew lead threshold days and the schedule charges no freight collection fee, the window is the schedule's label validity days plus the van slot days. Where that service offers a slot inside the crew lead threshold days, the window is the schedule's label validity days.

The crew lead threshold is 3 days. The freight slot days are 7. The van slot days are 3.

## The two things read

The window in question is the window over which a Northbeam Returns and Restocking collection booking is held open.

The service the item was delivered on is the fulfilment service recorded for that item on Northbeam Purchase Orders and Fulfilment, and the lead it needs is the shortest lead that service publishes. A service whose shortest lead is 3 days or more offers no slot inside the crew lead threshold days; a service whose shortest lead is fewer than 3 days offers one.

Whether the schedule charges a freight collection fee is read from the freight collection fee published against the return schedule the line falls under:

| Return schedule | Freight collection fee | Does the schedule charge one? |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Standard Fifteen Day Return | 0.00 USD | no |
| Member Extended Thirty Day Return | 0.00 USD | no |
| Major Appliance Forty Eight Hour Return | 89.00 USD | yes |
| Activated Wireless Device Return | 0.00 USD | no |
| Open Box and Clearance Final Sale | 0.00 USD | no |
| Business Contract Return Schedule | 125.00 USD | yes |

## The three combinations in full

| Shortest lead of the delivering service | Does the schedule charge a freight collection fee? | The window |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3 days or more | yes | the schedule's label validity days plus 7 |
| 3 days or more | no | the schedule's label validity days plus 3 |
| fewer than 3 days | yes or no, it makes no difference | the schedule's label validity days |

## Both sides of the threshold, on hypothetical inputs

*A delivering service whose shortest lead is 3 days, on a schedule charging a freight collection fee, the schedule's label validity days being 10.* Three days is not inside the crew lead threshold of 3 days, so the window is 10 plus 7, that is 17 days.

*The same delivering service on a schedule charging no freight collection fee.* The window is 10 plus 3, that is 13 days.

*A delivering service whose shortest lead is 2 days.* Two days is inside the crew lead threshold, so the window is the schedule's label validity days, 10.
